ambiguities.score_direction: Eq. 14 defines argtopk as maximising and Alg. 1 line 20 uses arg max, while Eq. 9-10 minimise and Eq. 13 carries a leading minus (negative log-likelihood + imbalance). Resolved: minimisation everywhere.
ambiguities.balance_prefix_vs_candidate: Alg. 1 line 14 writes sigma(M, new_candidate); Eq. 13 writes sigma(M, S) and Sec. 4.2 describes deferred expert balance that excludes v. Resolved: prefix S.
ambiguities.sigma_scale: Alg. 1 line 30 has sqrt(E/(E-1) sum ...), Eq. 4 has sqrt(1/(E-1) sum ...). Eq. 4 used (the factor E only rescales sigma, i.e. it would act like tau/E).
ambiguities.usage_frequency_normalisation: per-token rate (counts / tokens) vs share (counts / (tokens * k)) is not stated; the share would shrink the balance term by k = 4 (equivalent to tau x 4). Per-token rate adopted (rebuttal STD scale).
ambiguities.eq12_missing_log: Eq. 12 writes P(v|S) without log; Eq. 11/13 use log. Eq. 13 used.
ambiguities.first_token_distribution: Random(V): distribution, special-token handling and seed undocumented. The released EBSS_qwen.jsonl instead starts record i with token id i (sequential), which contradicts Random(V) or indicates a different script.
ambiguities.sequence_count_and_length: paper silent; rebuttal: 128 x 512; released file: 600 records up to ~2048 tokens.
ambiguities.eos_and_specials: no stop rule; whether specials / EOS were masked is undocumented. Not masked here.
ambiguities.per_sentence_vs_global_balance: sigma(M,S) is a property of one branch; no cross-sentence balance state is described. Per-branch adopted.
ambiguities.precision_and_batching_numerics: authors' precision undocumented; BF16 used (our checkpoint dtype). Batched KV decoding is not bitwise equal to a batch-1 replay (measured in smoke).
ambiguities.openreview_response: not accessible; nothing from it is used.
